## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: strong sector breadth but MAJOR DIVERGENCE across megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, META showing 1W vs 1M mismatch); Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Industrials lead: CAT (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +9.43% | 1M: -3.20%) RECOVERY. Financials strong: JPM (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND. Technology: INTC (1W: +33.58% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +10.35% | 1M: +3.58%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -7.92% | 1M: +3.84%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -6.77% | 1M: +1.82%) CORRECTION. Communication lagging: TMUS (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -9.14%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +33.58% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +15.37% | 1M: +16.74%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +14.38%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +13.29% | 1M: +1.62%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TMUS (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -9.14%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -20.06%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -13.90%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -9.91% | 1M: -17.77%) BELOW TREND; NKE (1W: -18.35% | 1M: -23.70%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple tech and consumer discretionary.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +33.58% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +15.37% | 1M: +16.74%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +14.38%) ABOVE TREND. Watch MAJOR DIVERGENCE in megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, META) — tactical moves, not full regime confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but powerful pockets of strength: INTC (1W: +33.58% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.85% | 1M: +13.80%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.40% | 1M: -0.31%) RECOVERY; INTU (1W: -9.91% | 1M: -17.77%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +4.75% (24 stocks) — strong leaders but internal dispersion.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Constructive: JPM (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and Financials 1W: +5.08% (20 stocks) showing breadth; V (1W: +2.22% | 1M: -2.22%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.49% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY — overall above-trend bias.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed defensives and idiosyncratic winners: UNH (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.30%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: +3.65% | 1M: -5.46%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W: +2.13% (17 stocks) — selective strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to industrials and bank/financial leaders (JPM, CAT) and high-conviction tech winners (INTC, AMAT) while reducing exposure to structurally weak names (NOW, TSLA, NKE); Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but mixed given broad sector strength and megacap divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +33.58% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.85% | 1M: +13.80%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.30%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: TSLA (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -13.90%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.91% | 1M: -17.77%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -7.78% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +5.27% | 15 stocks), Financials (1W: +5.08% | 20 stocks).  
BEARISH: Energy (1W: -4.62% | 10 stocks), Communication (1W: -0.57% | 10 stocks).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: reclaiming monthly highs would validate ABOVE TREND rotation; INTC: sustain post-breakout weekly gains to confirm accumulation; JPM: hold recent breakout above 1M trend to signal bank-led continuation; XOM: failure to reclaim weekly support risks further CORRECTION.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMAT (+60): AMAT (1W: +12.85% | 1M: +13.80%) ABOVE TREND — product launch news confirming price action.  
NVDA (+50): NVDA (1W: +4.40% | 1M: -0.31%) RECOVERY — sentiment aligns with 1W strength but 1M still negative.  
TSLA (+50): TSLA (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -13.90%) BELOW TREND — news bullish but price diverging, watch execution.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PSX (-55): PSX (1W: -7.78% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION — derivatives loss headlines confirm near-term weakness.  
INTU (-45): INTU (1W: -9.91% | 1M: -17.77%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both negative, downside risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt but narrow leadership. INTC (1W: +33.58% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +12.85% | 1M: +13.80%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major megacap divergence (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/META RECOVERY) and select negative news on PSX/INTU — monitor for confirmation.
